title: 高層建築核心筒滑模施工
subcategoryTitle: 混凝土與鋼構施工技術
summary: 滑模把核心筒牆體當成一條不停的生產線：約 1.2 m 高的模板由千斤頂沿爬桿每隔數分鐘上升一小段，下緣出模的混凝土必須已能自立，上方同時綁紮鋼筋、安裝埋件並澆置。本課以 CN Tower、ThyssenKrupp 羅特魏爾試驗塔與亞特蘭大電梯試驗塔為例，說明滑升速度與凝結時間、爬桿挫屈、埋件協調、垂直度與扭轉控制、冷縫與養護、以及竣工紀錄。
summaryEn: Slipforming turns a core wall into a non-stop production line: forms about 1.2 m high are jacked up rods a small step every few minutes, concrete leaving the bottom edge must already stand on its own, and above it crews fix rebar, set embeds and place concrete at the same time. Using the CN Tower, the ThyssenKrupp test tower in Rottweil and the elevator test tower in Atlanta, the course covers slip rate versus setting time, climbing-rod buckling, embed coordination, verticality and twist control, cold joints and curing, and as-built records.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「滑模原理與核心筒的適用條件」與「凝結時間、模板高度與容許滑升速度」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Slipform principle and when cores suit it" and "Setting time, form height and allowable slip rate": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 滑模原理與核心筒的適用條件：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Slipform principle and when cores suit it: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「連續滑升工序」如何影響高層建築核心筒滑模施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Continuous slipform cycle” governs force, deformation or durability in “Slipform construction of high-rise cores”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 滑模是一組沿牆體全周連續的模板，由頂部工作平台與軛架連成整體，千斤頂夾住埋在牆中的爬桿往上爬，帶動模板、平台與懸吊的修飾架一起上升。混凝土在模板內停留數小時，從頂部澆入、到下緣出模時已經初凝，可以支撐自身重量。因為模板不拆不組，核心筒每天可上升數公尺，但前提是斷面在高度方向少變化、開口與埋件能在滑升中連續安裝，且全天候不中斷供料。CN Tower 的混凝土塔身就是以液壓爬升千斤頂推動的模具連續成形，並在升高過程中逐步收窄形成錐形。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「連續滑升工序」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A slipform is a continuous ring of forms around the whole wall, tied by yokes to a working deck on top; jacks grip climbing rods embedded in the wall and climb them, lifting the forms, deck and hanging finishing scaffolds together. Concrete stays in the form for several hours, entering at the top and leaving the bottom edge after initial set, able to carry its own weight. Because nothing is struck and re-erected, a core can rise several metres a day, provided the section changes little with height, openings and embeds can be installed on the move and concrete supply continues around the clock. The CN Tower's concrete shaft was formed this way by a mould driven up by hydraulic climbing jacks, narrowing gradually as it rose to form the taper. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Continuous slipform cycle” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：滑升速度 0.10 m/h、全天 24 h 連續作業時日升 2.4 m；120 m 核心筒需 120/2.4 = 50 天，若計入 10% 的停機與調整時間，約需 50/0.9 ≈ 56 天。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: At 0.10 m/h around the clock the core rises 2.4 m a day; a 120 m core takes 120/2.4 = 50 days, or about 50/0.9 ≈ 56 days allowing 10% for stoppages and adjustments.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「滑模適用於所有高層核心筒，只要速度夠快就一定比較省工期。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Slipforming suits every high-rise core and is always faster if the rate is high enough." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「連續滑升工序」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Continuous slipform cycle”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 滑模原理與核心筒的適用條件
knowledge.titleEn: Slipform principle and when cores suit it
knowledge.text: 滑模是一組沿牆體全周連續的模板，由頂部工作平台與軛架連成整體，千斤頂夾住埋在牆中的爬桿往上爬，帶動模板、平台與懸吊的修飾架一起上升。混凝土在模板內停留數小時，從頂部澆入、到下緣出模時已經初凝，可以支撐自身重量。
knowledge.textEn: A slipform is a continuous ring of forms around the whole wall, tied by yokes to a working deck on top; jacks grip climbing rods embedded in the wall and climb them, lifting the forms, deck and hanging finishing scaffolds together. Concrete stays in the form for several hours, entering at the top and leaving the bottom edge after initial set, able to carry its own weight.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：滑模適用於所有高層核心筒，只要速度夠快就一定比較省工期。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Slipforming suits every high-rise core and is always faster if the rate is high enough. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「滑模原理與核心筒的適用條件」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Slipform principle and when cores suit it" is correct?
options: 滑模適用於所有高層核心筒，只要速度夠快就一定比較省工期。
滑模是一組沿牆體全周連續的模板，由頂部工作平台與軛架連成整體，千斤頂夾住埋在牆中的爬桿往上爬，帶動模板、平台與懸吊的修飾架一起上升。
滑模的速度越快越好，只要千斤頂能力足夠就可以一直加速。
optionsEn: Slipforming suits every high-rise core and is always faster if the rate is high enough.
A slipform is a continuous ring of forms around the whole wall, tied by yokes to a working deck on top.
The faster the slipform the better; it can keep accelerating as long as the jacks are strong enough.
quiz.explanation: 滑模是一組沿牆體全周連續的模板，由頂部工作平台與軛架連成整體，千斤頂夾住埋在牆中的爬桿往上爬，帶動模板、平台與懸吊的修飾架一起上升。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A slipform is a continuous ring of forms around the whole wall, tied by yokes to a working deck on top; jacks grip climbing rods embedded in the wall and climb them, lifting the forms, deck and hanging finishing scaffolds together. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 滑模原理與核心筒的適用條件：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Slipform principle and when cores suit it: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「連續滑升工序」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Continuous slipform cycle” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：滑升速度 0.10 m/h、全天 24 h 連續作業時日升 2.4 m；120 m 核心筒需 120/2.4 = 50 天，若計入 10% 的停機與調整時間，約需 50/0.9 ≈ 56 天。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At 0.10 m/h around the clock the core rises 2.4 m a day; a 120 m core takes 120/2.4 = 50 days, or about 50/0.9 ≈ 56 days allowing 10% for stoppages and adjustments. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在施工規劃階段比較滑模、跳模與自動爬模在工期、人力、混凝土供應與安全上的差異，確認核心筒斷面變化、開口數量、埋件密度與供料能力都支持連續作業；以排程模擬檢查預期停機次數。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At planning stage compare slipform, jump form and automatic climbing form for programme, labour, concrete supply and safety, and confirm that section changes, the number of openings, embed density and supply capacity all support continuous work; use schedule simulation to check the expected number of stoppages.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 滑升速度 0.10 m/h、全天 24 h 連續作業時日升 2.4 m；120 m 核心筒需 120/2.4 = 50 天，若計入 10% 的停機與調整時間，約需 50/0.9 ≈ 56 天。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: At 0.10 m/h around the clock the core rises 2.4 m a day; a 120 m core takes 120/2.4 = 50 days, or about 50/0.9 ≈ 56 days allowing 10% for stoppages and adjustments. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「滑模原理與核心筒的適用條件」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Slipform principle and when cores suit it", which statement holds?
options: 滑模速度快，所以埋件位置可以完工後再用鑽孔方式補做。
滑模混凝土是連續澆置的，所以牆內不會有施工縫。
滑升速度 0.10 m/h、全天 24 h 連續作業時日升 2.4 m。
optionsEn: Because slipforming is fast, embed positions can be added afterwards by drilling.
Slipformed walls are cast continuously, so they never contain construction joints.
At 0.10 m/h around the clock the core rises 2.4 m a day.
quiz.explanation: 滑升速度 0.10 m/h、全天 24 h 連續作業時日升 2.4 m；120 m 核心筒需 120/2.4 = 50 天，若計入 10% 的停機與調整時間，約需 50/0.9 ≈ 56 天。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: At 0.10 m/h around the clock the core rises 2.4 m a day; a 120 m core takes 120/2.4 = 50 days, or about 50/0.9 ≈ 56 days allowing 10% for stoppages and adjustments. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 滑模原理與核心筒的適用條件：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Slipform principle and when cores suit it: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「連續滑升工序」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Continuous slipform cycle” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在施工規劃階段比較滑模、跳模與自動爬模在工期、人力、混凝土供應與安全上的差異，確認核心筒斷面變化、開口數量、埋件密度與供料能力都支持連續作業；以排程模擬檢查預期停機次數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At planning stage compare slipform, jump form and automatic climbing form for programme, labour, concrete supply and safety, and confirm that section changes, the number of openings, embed density and supply capacity all support continuous work; use schedule simulation to check the expected number of stoppages. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：決定採用滑模前，要求建築與結構設計把牆厚變化、退縮與開口集中在少數高程，並與滑模專業廠商共同檢討；同時確認預拌廠與運輸能 24 小時供料，且有備援廠。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Before choosing slipform, ask the architectural and structural designers to concentrate wall-thickness changes, setbacks and openings at a few levels and review them with the slipform specialist; confirm that the ready-mix plant and haulage can supply 24 hours a day with a back-up plant.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：核心筒斷面每隔幾層就改變牆厚或退縮，滑模被迫頻繁停機改裝，連續作業的優勢消失，反而增加冷縫與品質風險；混凝土供應中斷時，模板內混凝土在靜止中與模板黏結，再啟動時表面被撕裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the core changes wall thickness or steps back every few storeys, the slipform must stop frequently for modification, losing its continuous advantage and adding cold joints and quality risk; if concrete supply is interrupted, concrete in the stationary form bonds to the panels and the surface tears when sliding resumes. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在施工規劃階段比較滑模、跳模與自動爬模在工期、人力、混凝土供應與安全上的差異，確認核心筒斷面變化、開口數量、埋件密度與供料能力都支持連續作業；以排程模擬檢查預期停機次數。
knowledge.textEn: At planning stage compare slipform, jump form and automatic climbing form for programme, labour, concrete supply and safety, and confirm that section changes, the number of openings, embed density and supply capacity all support continuous work; use schedule simulation to check the expected number of stoppages.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 決定採用滑模前，要求建築與結構設計把牆厚變化、退縮與開口集中在少數高程，並與滑模專業廠商共同檢討；同時確認預拌廠與運輸能 24 小時供料，且有備援廠。
knowledge.textEn: Before choosing slipform, ask the architectural and structural designers to concentrate wall-thickness changes, setbacks and openings at a few levels and review them with the slipform specialist; confirm that the ready-mix plant and haulage can supply 24 hours a day with a back-up plant.

quiz.question: 要驗證「滑模原理與核心筒的適用條件」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Slipform principle and when cores suit it"?
options: 在施工規劃階段比較滑模、跳模與自動爬模在工期、人力、混凝土供應與安全上的差異，確認核心筒斷面變化、開口數量、埋件密度與供料能力都支持連續作業。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
自動化液壓系統會讓所有千斤頂完全同步，不需要人工量測。
optionsEn: At planning stage compare slipform, jump form and automatic climbing form for programme, labour, concrete supply and safety, and confirm that section changes, the number of openings, embed density and supply capacity all support continuous work.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Automated hydraulics keep every jack perfectly synchronised, so manual levelling is unnecessary.
quiz.explanation: 在施工規劃階段比較滑模、跳模與自動爬模在工期、人力、混凝土供應與安全上的差異，確認核心筒斷面變化、開口數量、埋件密度與供料能力都支持連續作業；以排程模擬檢查預期停機次數。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: At planning stage compare slipform, jump form and automatic climbing form for programme, labour, concrete supply and safety, and confirm that section changes, the number of openings, embed density and supply capacity all support continuous work; use schedule simulation to check the expected number of stoppages. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 滑模原理與核心筒的適用條件：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Slipform principle and when cores suit it: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「連續滑升工序」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Continuous slipform cycle” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 核心筒斷面每隔幾層就改變牆厚或退縮，滑模被迫頻繁停機改裝，連續作業的優勢消失，反而增加冷縫與品質風險；混凝土供應中斷時，模板內混凝土在靜止中與模板黏結，再啟動時表面被撕裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If the core changes wall thickness or steps back every few storeys, the slipform must stop frequently for modification, losing its continuous advantage and adding cold joints and quality risk; if concrete supply is interrupted, concrete in the stationary form bonds to the panels and the surface tears when sliding resumes. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：CN Tower 的混凝土塔身就是以液壓爬升千斤頂推動的模具連續成形，並在升高過程中逐步收窄形成錐形。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The CN Tower's concrete shaft was formed this way by a mould driven up by hydraulic climbing jacks, narrowing gradually as it rose to form the taper.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「滑模適用於所有高層核心筒，只要速度夠快就一定比較省工期。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Slipforming suits every high-rise core and is always faster if the rate is high enough." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 核心筒斷面每隔幾層就改變牆厚或退縮，滑模被迫頻繁停機改裝，連續作業的優勢消失，反而增加冷縫與品質風險；混凝土供應中斷時，模板內混凝土在靜止中與模板黏結，再啟動時表面被撕裂。
knowledge.textEn: If the core changes wall thickness or steps back every few storeys, the slipform must stop frequently for modification, losing its continuous advantage and adding cold joints and quality risk; if concrete supply is interrupted, concrete in the stationary form bonds to the panels and the surface tears when sliding resumes.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「滑模原理與核心筒的適用條件」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Slipform principle and when cores suit it" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
核心筒斷面每隔幾層就改變牆厚或退縮，滑模被迫頻繁停機改裝，連續作業的優勢消失，反而增加冷縫與品質風險。
滑模的速度越快越好，只要千斤頂能力足夠就可以一直加速。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
If the core changes wall thickness or steps back every few storeys, the slipform must stop frequently for modification, losing its continuous advantage and adding cold joints and quality risk.
The faster the slipform the better; it can keep accelerating as long as the jacks are strong enough.
quiz.explanation: 核心筒斷面每隔幾層就改變牆厚或退縮，滑模被迫頻繁停機改裝，連續作業的優勢消失，反而增加冷縫與品質風險；混凝土供應中斷時，模板內混凝土在靜止中與模板黏結，再啟動時表面被撕裂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the core changes wall thickness or steps back every few storeys, the slipform must stop frequently for modification, losing its continuous advantage and adding cold joints and quality risk; if concrete supply is interrupted, concrete in the stationary form bonds to the panels and the surface tears when sliding resumes. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 凝結時間、模板高度與容許滑升速度：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Setting time, form height and allowable slip rate: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「出模混凝土強度」如何影響高層建築核心筒滑模施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Concrete strength at form exit” governs force, deformation or durability in “Slipform construction of high-rise cores”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 滑模的核心限制是：混凝土從頂部澆入到從下緣出模的時間，必須長於它達到初凝、可自立的時間。若滑升太快，出模混凝土仍呈塑性，會坍落、鼓出或被模板拖裂；若太慢，混凝土在模板內硬化並與模板黏結，滑升時表面被撕開。凝結時間受水泥種類、緩凝劑、混凝土溫度與氣溫強烈影響，所以滑升速度必須隨日夜溫度調整，而不是固定一個數字。亞特蘭大試驗塔的模板高約 1.2 m（4 ft）。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「出模混凝土強度」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The governing limit of slipforming is that the time from placing at the top to leaving the bottom edge must exceed the time the concrete needs to reach initial set and stand on its own. If sliding is too fast, concrete leaving the form is still plastic and slumps, bulges or is dragged and torn; if too slow, concrete hardens in the form and bonds to it, tearing the surface when sliding resumes. Setting time depends strongly on cement type, retarders, concrete temperature and air temperature, so the slip rate must follow day and night temperatures rather than stay fixed. The forms on the Atlanta test tower were about 1.2 m (4 ft) high. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Concrete strength at form exit” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：容許滑升速度 v_max ≈ h_eff/t_set。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Allowable slip rate v_max ≈ h_eff/t_set.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「滑模的速度越快越好，只要千斤頂能力足夠就可以一直加速。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The faster the slipform the better; it can keep accelerating as long as the jacks are strong enough." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「出模混凝土強度」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Concrete strength at form exit”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 凝結時間、模板高度與容許滑升速度
knowledge.titleEn: Setting time, form height and allowable slip rate
knowledge.text: 滑模的核心限制是：混凝土從頂部澆入到從下緣出模的時間，必須長於它達到初凝、可自立的時間。若滑升太快，出模混凝土仍呈塑性，會坍落、鼓出或被模板拖裂；若太慢，混凝土在模板內硬化並與模板黏結，滑升時表面被撕開。
knowledge.textEn: The governing limit of slipforming is that the time from placing at the top to leaving the bottom edge must exceed the time the concrete needs to reach initial set and stand on its own. If sliding is too fast, concrete leaving the form is still plastic and slumps, bulges or is dragged and torn; if too slow, concrete hardens in the form and bonds to it, tearing the surface when sliding resumes.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：滑模的速度越快越好，只要千斤頂能力足夠就可以一直加速。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The faster the slipform the better; it can keep accelerating as long as the jacks are strong enough. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「凝結時間、模板高度與容許滑升速度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Setting time, form height and allowable slip rate" is correct?
options: 滑模的速度越快越好，只要千斤頂能力足夠就可以一直加速。
千斤頂額定荷重夠大，就代表爬桿與平台一定安全。
滑模的核心限制是：混凝土從頂部澆入到從下緣出模的時間，必須長於它達到初凝、可自立的時間。
optionsEn: The faster the slipform the better; it can keep accelerating as long as the jacks are strong enough.
If the jack rating is high enough, the rods and deck must be safe.
The governing limit of slipforming is that the time from placing at the top to leaving the bottom edge must exceed the time the concrete needs to reach initial set and stand on its own.
quiz.explanation: 滑模的核心限制是：混凝土從頂部澆入到從下緣出模的時間，必須長於它達到初凝、可自立的時間。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The governing limit of slipforming is that the time from placing at the top to leaving the bottom edge must exceed the time the concrete needs to reach initial set and stand on its own. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 凝結時間、模板高度與容許滑升速度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Setting time, form height and allowable slip rate: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「出模混凝土強度」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Concrete strength at form exit” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：容許滑升速度 v_max ≈ h_eff/t_set。模板 1.2 m、頂部預留 0.2 m 時有效高度 h_eff = 1.0 m；20°C 時初凝 4 h，v_max = 1.0/4 = 0.25 m/h；10°C 時凝結時間約加倍為 8 h，v_max 降為 0.125 m/h。實際速度還要留裕度。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Allowable slip rate v_max ≈ h_eff/t_set. With a 1.2 m form and 0.2 m freeboard, h_eff = 1.0 m; at 20°C with initial set at 4 h, v_max = 1.0/4 = 0.25 m/h; at 10°C setting roughly doubles to 8 h and v_max drops to 0.125 m/h. Actual rates keep a margin below these. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：開工前以試拌在不同溫度做凝結時間試驗（貫入阻力法），建立溫度與初凝時間關係；施工中每班以手指按壓或小型貫入計檢查出模面，並記錄混凝土溫度、氣溫與滑升速度，速度調整需由滑模工程師簽記。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before starting, run setting-time tests by penetration resistance on trial batches at several temperatures to relate temperature to initial set; during work check the exit surface each shift by thumb pressure or a small penetrometer, log concrete temperature, air temperature and slip rate, and have the slipform engineer sign every rate change.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 容許滑升速度 v_max ≈ h_eff/t_set。模板 1.2 m、頂部預留 0.2 m 時有效高度 h_eff = 1.0 m；20°C 時初凝 4 h，v_max = 1.0/4 = 0.25 m/h；10°C 時凝結時間約加倍為 8 h，v_max 降為 0.125 m/h。實際速度還要留裕度。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Allowable slip rate v_max ≈ h_eff/t_set. With a 1.2 m form and 0.2 m freeboard, h_eff = 1.0 m; at 20°C with initial set at 4 h, v_max = 1.0/4 = 0.25 m/h; at 10°C setting roughly doubles to 8 h and v_max drops to 0.125 m/h. Actual rates keep a margin below these. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「凝結時間、模板高度與容許滑升速度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Setting time, form height and allowable slip rate", which statement holds?
options: 容許滑升速度 v_max ≈ h_eff/t_set。
滑模偏了只要在下一段一次調回原位即可。
混凝土在模板內放滿固定小時數就一定可以出模，與溫度無關。
optionsEn: Allowable slip rate v_max ≈ h_eff/t_set.
If the slipform drifts, it can simply be returned to position in the next lift.
Concrete can always leave the form after a fixed number of hours regardless of temperature.
quiz.explanation: 容許滑升速度 v_max ≈ h_eff/t_set。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Allowable slip rate v_max ≈ h_eff/t_set. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 凝結時間、模板高度與容許滑升速度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Setting time, form height and allowable slip rate: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「出模混凝土強度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Concrete strength at form exit” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 開工前以試拌在不同溫度做凝結時間試驗（貫入阻力法），建立溫度與初凝時間關係；施工中每班以手指按壓或小型貫入計檢查出模面，並記錄混凝土溫度、氣溫與滑升速度，速度調整需由滑模工程師簽記。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before starting, run setting-time tests by penetration resistance on trial batches at several temperatures to relate temperature to initial set; during work check the exit surface each shift by thumb pressure or a small penetrometer, log concrete temperature, air temperature and slip rate, and have the slipform engineer sign every rate change. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：施工計畫應以溫度—速度對照表管理滑升，並規定每班出模面檢查的方法與紀錄；配比中的緩凝劑用量變更須由混凝土供應商與滑模工程師共同同意並先做試驗。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Manage slipping with a temperature-versus-rate table in the method statement, specify how the exit surface is checked and recorded each shift, and require joint agreement and prior trials by the concrete supplier and slipform engineer for any change in retarder dosage.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：夜間降溫時仍維持白天速度，出模混凝土未凝結而坍落，牆面出現鼓脹與水平裂縫；白天高溫時速度太慢，混凝土黏住模板，滑升時表面被拉出水平撕裂帶，嚴重時鋼筋外露，需大面積修補。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Keeping the daytime rate as temperatures fall at night lets unset concrete slump out of the form, leaving bulges and horizontal cracks; sliding too slowly in daytime heat lets concrete bond to the form so that each lift drags out horizontal tear bands, in bad cases exposing bars and requiring extensive repair. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 開工前以試拌在不同溫度做凝結時間試驗（貫入阻力法），建立溫度與初凝時間關係；施工中每班以手指按壓或小型貫入計檢查出模面，並記錄混凝土溫度、氣溫與滑升速度，速度調整需由滑模工程師簽記。
knowledge.textEn: Before starting, run setting-time tests by penetration resistance on trial batches at several temperatures to relate temperature to initial set; during work check the exit surface each shift by thumb pressure or a small penetrometer, log concrete temperature, air temperature and slip rate, and have the slipform engineer sign every rate change.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 施工計畫應以溫度—速度對照表管理滑升，並規定每班出模面檢查的方法與紀錄；配比中的緩凝劑用量變更須由混凝土供應商與滑模工程師共同同意並先做試驗。
knowledge.textEn: Manage slipping with a temperature-versus-rate table in the method statement, specify how the exit surface is checked and recorded each shift, and require joint agreement and prior trials by the concrete supplier and slipform engineer for any change in retarder dosage.

quiz.question: 要驗證「凝結時間、模板高度與容許滑升速度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Setting time, form height and allowable slip rate"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
開工前以試拌在不同溫度做凝結時間試驗（貫入阻力法），建立溫度與初凝時間關係。

optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Before starting, run setting-time tests by penetration resistance on trial batches at several temperatures to relate temperature to initial set.

quiz.explanation: 開工前以試拌在不同溫度做凝結時間試驗（貫入阻力法），建立溫度與初凝時間關係；施工中每班以手指按壓或小型貫入計檢查出模面，並記錄混凝土溫度、氣溫與滑升速度，速度調整需由滑模工程師簽記。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before starting, run setting-time tests by penetration resistance on trial batches at several temperatures to relate temperature to initial set; during work check the exit surface each shift by thumb pressure or a small penetrometer, log concrete temperature, air temperature and slip rate, and have the slipform engineer sign every rate change. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 凝結時間、模板高度與容許滑升速度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Setting time, form height and allowable slip rate: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「出模混凝土強度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Concrete strength at form exit” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 夜間降溫時仍維持白天速度，出模混凝土未凝結而坍落，牆面出現鼓脹與水平裂縫；白天高溫時速度太慢，混凝土黏住模板，滑升時表面被拉出水平撕裂帶，嚴重時鋼筋外露，需大面積修補。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Keeping the daytime rate as temperatures fall at night lets unset concrete slump out of the form, leaving bulges and horizontal cracks; sliding too slowly in daytime heat lets concrete bond to the form so that each lift drags out horizontal tear bands, in bad cases exposing bars and requiring extensive repair. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：亞特蘭大試驗塔的模板高約 1.2 m（4 ft）。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The forms on the Atlanta test tower were about 1.2 m (4 ft) high.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「滑模的速度越快越好，只要千斤頂能力足夠就可以一直加速。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The faster the slipform the better; it can keep accelerating as long as the jacks are strong enough." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 夜間降溫時仍維持白天速度，出模混凝土未凝結而坍落，牆面出現鼓脹與水平裂縫；白天高溫時速度太慢，混凝土黏住模板，滑升時表面被拉出水平撕裂帶，嚴重時鋼筋外露，需大面積修補。
knowledge.textEn: Keeping the daytime rate as temperatures fall at night lets unset concrete slump out of the form, leaving bulges and horizontal cracks; sliding too slowly in daytime heat lets concrete bond to the form so that each lift drags out horizontal tear bands, in bad cases exposing bars and requiring extensive repair.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「凝結時間、模板高度與容許滑升速度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Setting time, form height and allowable slip rate" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
千斤頂額定荷重夠大，就代表爬桿與平台一定安全。
夜間降溫時仍維持白天速度，出模混凝土未凝結而坍落，牆面出現鼓脹與水平裂縫。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
If the jack rating is high enough, the rods and deck must be safe.
Keeping the daytime rate as temperatures fall at night lets unset concrete slump out of the form, leaving bulges and horizontal cracks.
quiz.explanation: 夜間降溫時仍維持白天速度，出模混凝土未凝結而坍落，牆面出現鼓脹與水平裂縫；白天高溫時速度太慢，混凝土黏住模板，滑升時表面被拉出水平撕裂帶，嚴重時鋼筋外露，需大面積修補。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Keeping the daytime rate as temperatures fall at night lets unset concrete slump out of the form, leaving bulges and horizontal cracks; sliding too slowly in daytime heat lets concrete bond to the form so that each lift drags out horizontal tear bands, in bad cases exposing bars and requiring extensive repair. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
